name: RSE-Fixes
description: Part of RSE (RuneScape Enhanced). 0.1 investigates walking through player-built pieces after joining or teleporting: it logs what your game knows about the buildings around you. It changes nothing in the game yet.

settings.label: Automatic reports
settings.tooltip: After a teleport, join or respawn, and when your footing turns unstable, write a short report on nearby buildings to UE4SS.log.

settings.label: Teleport distance (m)
settings.tooltip: Distance moved within a quarter of a second that counts as a teleport.

settings.label: Log building diagnostics now
settings.tooltip: Writes a full report now and short ones after 2, 5 and 10 seconds. Same as the console command fixes_buildings.
